notes.title: Update 1.0.0.03
notes.notes:
Greetings, dearies!

This update brings a few fixes as well as an update to the Godot 4.4.1 Engine for some potential performance improvements.

[list]
[*] Players may press 'Enter' in missions to make all deployed units enter Attack Mode
[*] Bugfix for Laboratory Volunteers
[*] Bugfix for enemy units getting stuck in floor
[*] Bugfix for 'Defeat Enemy' Objectives not triggering
[/list]

As always, feel free to reach out to ghostiegamesdev@proton.me for any feedback or bug reports.

Stay Spooky!

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.02
notes.notes:
Greetings, dearies!

While the launch of Mobs 'N Monsters has been going relatively smoothly, there were some small fixes and tweaks I wanted to push out as soon as possible after seeing some feedback. This update includes:
[list]
[*]Mob Mode now toggle-able! This Hard Mode (once unlocked) can now be freely toggled on or off before selecting a mission. Description was also updated for clarity.
[*]RIP Label now appears over slain unit buttons during missions. 
[*]Monsters who volunteer for experiments will be EXEMPT from rent until they return.
[*]Typographical fixes
[*]New Game bugfix

I will continue collecting feedback and updating as needed. Please reach out if you come across any issues ( ghostiegamesdev@proton.me ) and leave a review on the Store Page when you get a moment. Until next time, stay spooky!
[/list]

notes.title: Mobs 'N Monsters Releases April 11, 2025
notes.notes:
We are in the home stretch, dearies! Release day is just over a week away. We can't wait to see what everyone thinks of this chaotic take on the tower defense genre. We'll have a nice launch week discount for our biggest supporters, so keep your eyes peeled for that!

In the meantime, why not check out our previous game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2638610/Spotless/]Spotless, the Cleaning Rogue Lite[/url]? It's a challenging love letter to the GameBoy era and loaded with spoopy vibes. We even recently added a new site inspired by Mobs 'N Monsters- Dr. Malice's Laboratory!

Happy Gaming and Stay Spooky!
